description: This file defines the NoteEditorController class, which manages the editing and observing of a note in a Flutter application. It interacts with the notes repository to observe, create, update, and delete notes, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: NoteEditorController
classes.description: Controller class for editing notes, handles observing, saving, and deleting notes, and notifies Flutter widgets of state changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the editor by observing the note if noteId is provided.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Creates a new note or updates an existing one with provided title and content.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current note if it exists.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the stream subscription when the controller is disposed.
